verdict.rationale: MoonPay is a crypto on-ramp and off-ramp payments platform, and such a platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on transaction or account data, so the axis applies. The pack shows no in-product AI insights or suggestions drawn from user data. The only AI-related evidence is a documentation MCP server that lets agents search and retrieve docs content, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
